examples.name: Empty rectangular channel
examples.notes: Single inlet filling a straight channel: the outlet equals the inlet (identity map).

examples.name: Three serial inlets
examples.notes: Serial top-wall ports narrower than the channel: curved, nested layers.

examples.name: Unequal 2x2 inlet array
examples.notes: Non-separable per-inlet flow rates; the legacy array operator ignores them.

examples.name: Off-center bottom-mounted right triangle
examples.notes: Asymmetric partial-height pillar (h/H = 0.6) off the channel centreline.

examples.name: Reflected right triangle
examples.notes: Mirror image of right_triangle_bottom about the channel centreline (y -> W - y).

examples.name: Top-mounted right triangle
examples.notes: Top-mounted variant; the legacy lubrication-divergence model has no top mount.

examples.name: Two nearby pillars
examples.notes: Pillars 150 um apart interact; they are solved as one coupled group.

examples.name: Viscosity contrast (experimental)
examples.notes: 4:1 viscosity ratio: flux-constrained layers and viscosity-coupled Stokes iteration (experimental).

examples.name: Pressure-driven serial inlets
examples.notes: Inlet pressures behind tubing resistances; flow rates come from the hydraulic network.
